event.title: US Suspends Trade Benefits for South Africa and Rwanda
event.canonical_title: US Suspends Trade Benefits for South Africa and Rwanda
event.summary: The Trump administration has announced the suspension of duty-free trade access for South Africa and Rwanda, citing violations of the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA). This decision will impact approximately $1.7 billion in annual exports from South Africa, including cars and agricultural products. The US government attributed the move to practices deemed inconsistent with the eligibility criteria of the trade initiative, which is a key aspect of US economic relations with sub-Saharan Africa.

timeline.title: Trump to Exclude Rwanda and South Africa from US Trade Program
timeline.summary: The Trump administration has announced the removal of Rwanda and South Africa from the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA) trade program. This decision follows recent sanctions imposed by the US Treasury on Rwanda's defense ministry.
